name: Bauernhof Großpointerhof & Haus Haselberger
beschreibung: The Großpointerhof and Haus Haselberger are nestled on the outskirts of Ebbs, a charming town in the Tyrolean Unterland near the Bavarian border. The estate features comfortable holiday apartments alongside a traditional gasthof serving authentic regional dishes. Guests can look forward to a welcoming countryside ambience with scenic panoramas over lush meadows and the majestic Kaisergebirge mountain range. Farm animals reside on the property, providing authentic encounters with Alpine agriculture, and a freshly prepared breakfast is served daily.
